 <div class="dmRespRow u_1465882171" id="1465882171"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1127265496"> <div class="dmRespCol large-12 medium-12 small-12 u_1475927552" id="1475927552"> <div class="u_1318324109 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1318324109" style="text-align: left; display: block;" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJ2aWV3cG9ydCIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6ImZhZGVJbkNvbWJvIiwicmV2ZXJzZSI6ZmFsc2UsImludGVuc2l0eSI6MSwidmlld3BvcnRUaHJlc2hvbGRzIjp7InRvcCI6IjI0JSIsImJvdHRvbSI6IjAlIn0sImRlbGF5IjowLCJkdXJhdGlvbiI6MSwiZGlyIjoiaW4tcGxhY2UifX0="><p class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Whether you're an adrenaline junkie or a nature lover, the</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Namibian Downwinder Kitesurfing Safari</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">offers a once-in-a-lifetime journey across one of the most dramatic coastlines on Earth. This 10-day expedition takes you through the heart of the Namib Sand Sea&mdash;a UNESCO World Heritage Site&mdash;combining world-class kitesurfing with rugged 4x4 dune exploration.</span></span></p><p class="text-align-left"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="text-decoration: underline; display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">🌊 The Adventure of a Lifetime</span></p><p class="text-align-left" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">This safari is designed for</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">experienced kitesurfers</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">who crave freedom and flexibility. Our 5-day &quot;Epic Downwinder&quot; spans roughly 280km of pristine coastline, passing forgotten shipwrecks like the Eduard Bohlen (1909) and the Shawnee (1976), and visiting legendary spots like Donkey Bay&mdash;home to one of the world's best left-hand waves.</span></span></p><p class="text-align-left"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Trip Highlights</span></p> <ul class="defaultList bullet"><li class="text-align-left" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></li><li class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Epic Downwinders:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Multi-day coastal runs from St. Francis Bay back to Swakopmund.</span></span></li><li class="text-align-left"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></li><li class="text-align-left" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></li><li class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Wild Camping:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Experience &quot;camping wild&quot; in 3x3m dome tents under the vast Namibian stars, situated right between the dunes and the Atlantic.</span></span></li><li class="text-align-left"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></li><li class="text-align-left" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></li><li class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">4x4 Dune Driving:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Navigate massive dune fields in specialized off-road vehicles.</span></span></li><li class="text-align-left"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></li><li class="text-align-left" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></li><li class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Safety First:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Our support vehicles follow along the shore, ensuring we always have an eye on you.</span></span></li><li class="text-align-left"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></li></ul> 
<p class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration: underline;">🗓️ 10-Day Itinerary at a Glance</span></p><p class="text-align-left" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration: underline;">Day Activity &amp; Location</strong></p><p class="text-align-left" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">-1</strong><span style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;">&nbsp;</span> 
</span><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);" class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18">Arrival &amp; Capitol City Exploration Windhoek</span> 
</span></p><p class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18" style="direction: ltr; line-height: 1.15;"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">-2</strong><span style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;">&nbsp;</span>
